@graph.headline: Manikarnika Ghat Varanasi: History, Significance, Location and Visit Guide
@graph.description: Guide to Manikarnika Ghat Varanasi covering history and significance, exact location, how to reach, and respectful visit information.

acceptedAnswer.text: Manikarnika Ghat is the principal cremation ghat in Varanasi where Hindu last rites are performed continuously.
It is famous for the belief that cremation at Manikarnika Ghat helps the departed attain moksha, making it one of the holiest cremation grounds in Kashi.

mainEntity.name: Where is Manikarnika Ghat located in Varanasi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Manikarnika Ghat is located on the old-city Ganga riverfront in Kashi/Banaras and is usually approached through lane-based pedestrian access.

mainEntity.name: How can I reach Manikarnika Ghat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Travel by taxi, auto, or e-rickshaw to nearby entry points such as Godowlia or Maidagin, then walk the final stretch through old-city lanes.

mainEntity.name: Is Manikarnika Ghat near Kashi Vishwanath Temple?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Manikarnika Ghat lies in the wider old-city Kashi Vishwanath riverfront zone and is generally reached through lane-based walking access.

mainEntity.name: What is the best cab drop point for Manikarnika Ghat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Godowlia is the most common drop point for Manikarnika Ghat. Maidagin-Chowk is often a better backup when congestion or barricades affect Godowlia access.
Yes, tourists can visit, but it is a place of mourning. Maintain strict respect and avoid photography of cremation rituals.

mainEntity.name: Is there a fee to enter Manikarnika Ghat?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no official entry fee for visiting Manikarnika Ghat. Be careful if anyone demands money for access.
